entries.name: assessBaselineRisk
entries.description: Pass 1 of the KYC risk pipeline: deterministic pre-screening risk for a KycCase (geography, ownership, document quality, source of funds, source of wealth, sanctions=UNKNOWN until screened). Also returns required-field issues and the normalized screeningSubject (ISO country codes, typed identifiers) to screen.

kycCase.description: A KycCase: { caseId, subject: { partyType: 'legalEntity'|'person', id, displayName, registrationNumber?, jurisdictionOfIncorporation? (ISO alpha-2), incorporationDate?, addresses[], roles[] }, relatedParties[], ownership[], evidence[{ documentId, type, fileName, issuer?, issuePlace?, issueDate? }], screeningResults[], issues[] }.

entries.name: amendCase
entries.description: Pass 2 of the KYC risk pipeline: amend a KycCase with sanctions screening results and the LLM's per-candidate disposition, apply merge treatment by confidence, replace the pre-screening sanctions factor, recompute final risk and score, and derive the recommendation, issues and required compliance actions. Works with zero candidates (clean screen).

screening.description: The sanctions screening result: { subject, status: 'CLEAR'|'MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED'|'REJECT', hits: [{ entryId, sourceRecordId, source, primaryName, matchedName, addresses[], identifiers[], ... }], candidatesExamined } — as produced by the kyc-screen-certificate lens.

amlAssessment.description: LLM disposition: { subjectName, overallStatus: 'CLEAR'|'MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED'|'REJECT', rationale, analystAction, candidateAssessments: [{ sourceRecordId, candidateName, confidenceScore 0..1, confidenceLevel: 'LOW'|'MEDIUM'|'HIGH', recommendedDisposition: 'LIKELY_FALSE_POSITIVE'|'POSSIBLE_MATCH'|'CONFIRMED_MATCH', rationale, missingEvidence: string[] }] }. Omit or pass no candidates for a clean screen.
